blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Heavy traffic was observed along the northbound portion of the North Luzon Expressway (NLEx), from Pulilan to the Candaba Viaduct, due to road crashes on Monday morning, the NLEx Corporation said. In its latest traffic update issued at 9:50 a.m., NLEx Corporation said traffic was moving at approximately 20 to 30 kilometers per hour in the affected portion.
